name: caesium-web
description: A modern, privacy aware web app to compress images, all offline and within the browser.

variables.name: Max batch file count
variables.description: Amount of files allowed to be added to the list in the same batch.

variables.name: Max file size for each image
variables.description: Max limit for each image size, in bytes.

variables.name: Public API Endpoint
variables.description: The endpoint where you can send compression stats.

variables.name: Send usage reports
variables.description: Send usage stats for the compressed images to the NUXT_PUBLIC_API_ENDPOINT. Set it to false if you don't care about it.
